## Summary

Fix the running status’s revision length so it matches history and completion output. This review read both changed files and all repository tests; tests were not run.

## Changes
The pull request adds a running-deployment status formatter containing a shortened revision and attempt number, plus tests for attempt formatting.

(none)

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — Use the existing 12-character revision identifier — For revision `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`, `status(revision, 2)` displays `0123456`, while history and completion display `0123456789ab`. Your new formatter uses `revision[:7]` despite its documented promise to use “the same identifier as history,” whose implementation uses `revision[:12]`. The added status test checks only the prefix and attempt suffix. — Users see inconsistent identifiers for the same deployment across running, history, and completion output.
